home.live.title: Run it yourself
home.live.lede: CIND3R3LLA is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. Read every line, run it on your own infrastructure, and modify it. An archive asks a community for trust, and the licence is what makes that trust checkable rather than promised.
home.how.title: A control plane for intelligent identities
home.how.lede: CIND3R3LLA is a self hosted control plane for intelligent identities inside private and public communities. It brings the embedded core, deterministic application logic, local language models, persistent community memory, human supervision, moderation workflows, knowledge publishing and character driven interaction together in one platform, running on hardware you control.
home.tile.consent.title: Privolitev na prvem mestu
home.tile.consent.body: Nič ne gre skozi brez izrecne privolitve skupine. Privolitev se preveri pred zajemom, nikoli se ne predpostavlja in jo je mogoče kadar koli preklicati.
home.tile.secure.title: Varno po zasnovi
home.tile.secure.body: Passkeys brez gesel, šifriran prenos, mediji, zaščiteni z avtentikacijo, popolno revizijsko beleženje. Varnost je temelj, ne dodatek.
home.tile.archived.title: Nato arhivirano
home.tile.archived.body: Le kar prestane pregled, postane trajen javni zapis, po katerem je mogoče iskati. Vse drugo se preprosto nikoli ne pojavi.
home.suite.title: What the platform does
home.suite.lede: The consent first archive is one capability among several, not the product.
home.suite.archive.title: Javni spletni arhiv
home.suite.archive.body: Zajem s privolitvijo, polnobesedilno iskanje, filtri, neskončno drsenje, predvajanje videa in javne strani, prijazne do iskalnikov. Zgrajen zato, da skupno znanje skupnosti ostane najdljivo leta, ne pokopano v zgodovini klepeta.
home.suite.roadmap.title: Na načrtu razvoja
home.sec.title: Part of the architecture, not a checkbox
home.sec.lede: Passkeys as the primary administrative login, an admin console bound to loopback behind TLS, originals encrypted at rest, metadata stripped before publication, and every state changing action written to an audit trail.
home.sec.point1: Passkeys first, with a break glass path the operator controls
home.sec.point2: Media originals encrypted at rest, public copies stripped of metadata
home.sec.point3: Consent enforced in the database view, not in a flag somebody can forget
home.sec.point4: Audit coverage on every administrative action
demo.consent: Vsaka skupina je privolila. Preklic je mogoč kadar koli.
demo.search.label: Iskanje po arhivu
features.cap1.title: Zajem s privolitvijo
features.cap1.body: Bot se pridruži javni skupini in vpraša, preden karkoli prebere. Zajem se začne šele po izrecni privolitvi in se ustavi v trenutku, ko je privolitev preklicana. Vsaka privolitev in vsak preklic se zabeležita, zato lahko arhiv vedno dokaže, zakaj je sporočilo v njem.
features.cap2.body: Srce požarnega zidu: vsaka slika in vsak video se zgostita in preverita v bazah znanega gradiva o zlorabah, preden ju je mogoče shraniti. Označeni mediji so blokirani in nikoli ne dosežejo arhiva. Operater jih vidi v vrsti za pregled, nikjer drugje.
features.cap3.title: Javni spletni arhiv
features.cap3.body: Objavi se le, kar prestane pregled. Kar ostane, postane trajne javne strani: polnobesedilno iskanje po vsakem sporočilu, filtri po skupini, avtorju, datumu in medijih, neskončno drsenje, vgrajeni video in stabilni URL-ji, prijazni do iskalnikov. Iskalniki jih indeksirajo, ljudje jih zares najdejo.
features.cap4.title: Prijave in moderiranje
features.cap4.body: Druga obrambna črta za pregledom: vsakdo lahko prijavi objavljeno sporočilo. Prijave prispejo v operaterjevo konzolo v pregled, odstranitev in revizijo. Moderiranje je prvorazreden delovni tok, ne naknadna misel.
features.roadmap.title: Načrtovane zmožnosti
features.roadmap.lede: V razvoju ali snovanju. Vrstni red in obseg se lahko spremenita, ker gre za programsko opremo v alfi in raje najprej izdamo varovala.
features.rm.matrix.body: Isti arhiv s privolitvijo na prvem mestu in ista zbirka botov za sobe Matrix.
features.rm.videogallery.body: Namenska površina za brskanje po arhiviranih videih in slikah.
features.rm.moderation.body: Množična dejanja, pravila in vrste za pregledovalce.
features.rm.localai.body: Pregledovanje in povzetki, ki tečejo na vaši lastni strojni opremi.
pro.title: CIND3R3LLA Pro
pro.lede: Upravljano gostovanje in zmožnosti onkraj odprtega jedra, za operaterje, ki želijo arhiv brez upravljanja infrastrukture. Ista varovala, isti odprti temelj, nič dela s strežniki.
pro.tile1.title: Upravljano gostovanje
pro.tile1.body: Mi poganjamo bote, arhiv in posodobitve. Vi obdržite operativni nadzor in svoje podatke, strežnika pa se nikoli ne dotaknete.
pro.tile2.title: Onkraj odprtega jedra
pro.tile2.body: Zmožnosti, ki so na voljo samo v izdaji Pro, pridejo najprej sem: napredno moderiranje, analitika in upravljanje več arhivov. Odprto jedro ostaja popolno tudi samo zase.
pro.tile3.title: Podpora, ki odgovori
pro.tile3.body: Neposreden kanal do ekipe, ki stoji za projektom CIND3R3LLA, z zavezami glede odzivnih časov. Brez zahtevkov, ki izginejo v črni luknji.
pro.pricing.title: Paketi
pro.pricing.lede: Cene se dokončno oblikujejo med alfo. Spodnji zneski so zgolj začasni, zgodnje zanimanje pa nam pomaga oblikovati pakete.
pro.tier1.name: Lastno gostovanje
pro.tier1.desc: Celotno odprto jedro, AGPL-3.0. Vaša strojna oprema, vaša pravila.
pro.tier2.name: Pro
pro.tier2.desc: Upravljano gostovanje in zmožnosti Pro, vse vodimo za vas.
pro.tier3.name: Enterprise
pro.tier3.desc: Več arhivov, prilagojeni pogoji in pomoč pri namestitvi.
pro.customer.title: Ste že stranka?
pro.customer.body: Prijavite se v svoje delovno okolje Pro ali pustite naslov in pisali vam bomo, ko se odpre uvajanje. Med alfo stranke sprejemamo v majhnih skupinah.
security.tile1.title: Brez gesel
security.tile1.body: Passkeys (WebAuthn / FIDO2): vezani na napravo, odporni na phishing in napade z grobo silo. Brez deljenih gesel, nič, kar bi lahko ušlo ali bilo znova uporabljeno.
security.tile2.title: Vaši podatki ostanejo vaši
security.tile2.body: Najmanjše potrebne pravice in izolacija. Z načrtovano lokalno AI pregledovanje in pogovori nikoli ne zapustijo vaše infrastrukture, zaupati pa ni treba nobenemu tretjemu obdelovalcu.
security.tile3.title: Prijave in odstranjevanje
security.tile3.body: Druga obrambna črta za pregledom: vsakdo lahko prijavi objavljeno vsebino. Operater jo pregleda in odstrani, vsako dejanje pa se zapiše v revizijski dnevnik.
security.vuln.title: Ste našli ranljivost?
security.vuln.body: Prijavite jo zasebno prek varnostnega kontakta v repozitoriju. Odgovorno razkritje javno priznamo in vsako prijavo jemljemo resno.
os.title: Odprto jedro, odprte knjige
os.lede: Jedro projekta CIND3R3LLA je prosta programska oprema pod licenco AGPL-3.0. Poganjajte ga sami, preberite vsako vrstico in nas držite za besedo glede trditev te strani. Zaupanje mora biti preverljivo, ne obljubljeno.
os.repo.title: Repozitorij
os.repo.body: Izvorna koda, zahtevki, razprave o načrtu razvoja in varnostna politika so na GitHubu. Prispevki so dobrodošli, od popravkov tipkarskih napak do celih zmožnosti, in vsaka sprememba se zgodi javno.
os.why.title: Zakaj AGPL-3.0
os.why.body: Arhiv zahteva zaupanje. AGPL zagotavlja, da mora vsak, ki poganja spremenjeno različico bota CIND3R3LLA, te spremembe objaviti, zato lahko javnost vedno pregleda kodo, ki obdeluje javne pogovore. Prav to je naloga te licence.

hero.lede: Local AI, human controlled agents, autonomous NPCs, consent first community memory and a hardened administration platform. One embedded core, your own infrastructure, and no silent cloud fallback.
home.cap.ai.title: Local AI runtime
home.cap.ai.body: Inference runs against your own Ollama endpoint, with independent model routing for intent classification and for reply wording. Connections are probed before activation, a missing model refuses to activate, and when the model is unavailable the deterministic rule engine answers. There is no silent cloud fallback.
home.cap.identities.title: Multi profile identities
home.cap.identities.body: One embedded core hosts many persistent profiles without one process per bot. Actor type, automation mode, personality, permissions, avatar source and public role are separate settings: a fantasy avatar does not decide whether an identity is human operated, autonomous or purely technical.
home.cap.npcs.title: NPCs and characters
home.cap.npcs.body: Autonomous characters host games, explain features, welcome new members, tell context aware jokes and create roleplay moments. Scheduling, permissions, context access, message limits and cooldowns are deterministic. The model supplies the wording, never the decision.
home.cap.agents.title: Human operated agents
home.cap.agents.body: A moderator works through a persistent avatar, discusses difficult situations with the team in a private staff space, refines the behaviour, and continues in the public conversation as the same identity. Assisted mode, autopilot and immediate human takeover, with approval requirements and an audit history.
home.cap.memory.title: Consent first community memory
home.cap.memory.body: Opted in conversation becomes a searchable public archive the community owns. Publication is derived from consent on every read rather than stored as a flag, so a withdrawal takes effect everywhere at once, and the member then chooses whether their words are hidden or destroyed.
home.cap.admin.title: Administration platform
home.cap.admin.body: Every capability has a real control, a stored setting shown separately from its effective runtime state, audit coverage and documented failure behaviour. No hidden behaviour, and no controls that are not wired to anything.
home.cap.safety.title: Moderation and safety
home.cap.safety.body: Public reporting, an operator review queue, audited takedowns, evidence holds that defer destruction without ever delaying hiding, and quarantine that moves material out of the served tree entirely.
home.cap.selfhost.title: Self hosted under AGPL
home.cap.selfhost.body: Your server, your database, your models, your rules. The source is AGPL 3.0, so anyone operating a modified version owes their users the same freedoms. No cloud dependency and no vendor in the middle of your community.
home.control.title: The model never gets authority
home.control.lede: This is the line the whole architecture is drawn around. AI may classify a message and phrase a reply. It never receives permission to execute, to change consent, to publish, or to send arbitrary messages. Identity, permissions, routing, publication and execution stay in deterministic application code.
home.control.point1: A responsible human stays behind every supervised identity and can observe, interrupt, edit, approve or take over at any moment.
home.control.point2: A human operated identity is never silently converted into an autonomous one.
home.control.point3: Nobody can publish or unpublish on another member’s behalf, not an administrator, not the operator, not the model.
hero.rot2: communities that run their own AI
hero.rot3: agents a human can always take over
